body: Render nit while you amend: please make the length prefix part of EVERY encoded atom, including list elements and composite participant/location strings, not a separate length token only in field(). ContentAddress.digest NUL-joins its vector; a separate [length, raw] token pair still lets an embedded NUL re-segment the raw token. A self-delimiting single atom of decimal-length + colon + raw value, applied uniformly before joining, remains parseable across embedded NUL; keep the version marker as the first encoded atom. Add at least a list-element NUL forgery alongside outcome/cause so the ADR claim every value is true.
